result.rationale: Verified in the diff: parseRefreshTokenResponse sets `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"` when missing, and office365calendar does `o365AuthCredentials = { ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) }` before persisting via prisma.credential.update — so the placeholder overwrites the stored real refresh_token, breaking future refreshes. Also the code drops the earlier error-logging/early-return path that previously guarded against saving invalid tokens.

judged_text: Placeholder refresh_token: "refresh_token" is injected in both sync and non-sync modes whenever parsed data lacks refresh_token, and callers spreading parsed data over stored credentials (e.g., office365calendar) will clobber the real refresh token, permanently breaking future refreshes
